steps.shell: echo 'Starting AI diagnosis...' && cli-agent "Analyze this build failure and propose a fix (do not apply changes). Project: $PROJECT_NAME. Script: $SCRIPT_NAME. Failed step: $FAILED_STEP. Read the log file at $LOG_FILE for full output. After analyzing, show the proposed fix and suggest running /pr-check to test locally."
terminal-notifier -title 'Diagnosis Complete' -message 'Check Claude session for proposed fix' -sound default
echo '🔥 Warming Turborepo cache from main branch...'
FEATURE_BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current) && git stash push -m 'pr-check temp stash' --include-untracked
git checkout main && git pull origin main
FEATURE_BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD@{1}) && git checkout $FEATURE_BRANCH
git stash pop || echo 'No stash to restore (working tree was clean)'
echo '✅ Cache warmed. Running validation on feature branch...'

on_failure.shell: echo 'PR check failed at step: $FAILED_STEP' && echo 'Error: $FAILED_ERROR'

steps.shell: PR_URL=$(gh pr view --json url -q '.url' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$PR_URL" ] && echo '⚠️ No PR found, skipping watch.' && exit 0; scout watch-builds "$PR_URL"

pr:watch.shell: PR_URL=$(gh pr view --json url -q '.url' 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$PR_URL" ] && scout watch-builds "$PR_URL" || echo '❌ No PR found for current branch. Create a PR first with: gh pr create'

pr:diagnose.description: Watch PR and diagnose failures with proposed fixes

steps.shell: PR_URL=$(gh pr view --json url -q '.url' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$PR_URL" ] && echo '❌ No PR found. Create one first.' && exit 1; scout watch-builds "$PR_URL"

on_success.shell: echo '✅ All checks passed!' && terminal-notifier -title 'PR Ready' -message 'All checks passed! Ready to merge.' -sound default

pr:automerge.description: Watch PR checks, auto-merge when passing

steps.shell: PR_URL=$(gh pr view --json url -q '.url' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$PR_URL" ] && echo '❌ No PR found. Create one first.' && exit 1; scout watch-builds "$PR_URL"

on_success.shell: echo '✅ Merging PR...' && gh pr merge --auto --squash

/.clean: find . -name dist -type d -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find . -name .next -type d -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null
/.clean:dist: find . -name dist -type d -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find . -name .next -type d -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null
/.clean:all: find . -name dist -type d -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find . -name .next -type d -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; rm -rf .turbo; find . -name '*.generated.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -delete
/.clean -a: find . -name dist -type d -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find . -name .next -type d -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; rm -rf .turbo; find . -name '*.generated.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -delete
/.reset: yarn install && yarn lib:build && yarn gql:codegen
